description: A community identity profile record. Stores information about what a person practices, how they want to collaborate, and where their work can be found. Additive to app.bsky.actor.profile — intended to be read alongside it, not instead of it.

main.description: A user's community profile. Singleton record — one per DID.

focus.description: What this person actively practices or works in. Free-form strings — no controlled vocabulary enforced at the schema level.

platformLinks.description: Identity across platforms. Each entry names a platform, provides a URL, and an optional human-readable label.

collaborationStatus.description: Whether this person is open to collaboration.

collaborationInterests.description: Focus areas or skills wanted in collaborators. Free-form strings.

featuredLinks.description: Links to external work, projects, or resources. Each entry has a URL and an optional label.

featuredItems.description: AT URIs pointing to native Atmosphere objects — posts, collections, feeds, etc. Supplements the single pinnedPost in app.bsky.actor.profile.

label.description: Optional human-readable label, e.g. a username or page name.

featuredLink.description: An external URL with an optional display label.

label.description: Optional display label for the link.
